scope: All 23 Gold7 requirements, current pure Rust project; no new public components; performance acceptance remains deferred.
status_policy: Implemented code and deterministic tests do not establish native experience. Missing is never not-applicable. A requirement stays partial until all its child gaps are closed.

repairs.description: Real input/Button shared ROW/COLUMN layout, JSON gap, narrow wrapping, actual Clear action
Standalone action/state-matrix/brand-preview buttons follow BUTTON_CONTENT center; navigation/menu/list leading preserved
JSON 2pt width/2pt offset, neutral ring independent of required/error boundary, actual ancestor clipping
Capture only on successful drag; cancel/rollback/late-event coverage at model/view/adapter
Menu-owned scroll tick/needs_animation/ReducedMotion through Menu/Select/ComboBox/CommandPalette
Gallery preference propagation now includes navigation search
Marked composition sampled before blur, matching pointer submit/confirmation blocked; committed later input remains usable
Real Button paint consumes c-button-xs/sm/md/lg-radius; legacy direct painters use md alias without breaking callers
Arrow/Home/End restore a feasible two-pane layout after narrow-mode selection, including clamped endpoints
ComboBox/CommandPalette popup owns wheel events and consumes them before background scrolling; 24-item actual overflow fixtures test Reduced Motion and elastic paths
Real ancestor clips, token focus gutter, full owned control frames, keyboard scroll reveal and Menu/Dialog spacing
JSON Menu/Popover/Dialog elevation reaches actual Gaussian GPU pixels; panels and increased-contrast themes stay shadow-free
Production Button hover/press, Switch thumb and Disclosure body use JSON bindings, interruption and Reduced Motion
Host starts animation requests discovered by the first scene build and stops when completed
Deactivation and late inactive MouseUp clear stale hover/capture/presentation channels

Production Menu/Dialog/Popover own JSON-driven enter/exit paint while semantic close immediately releases hit/focus; live glyphs rebuilt each frame; interruption, Reduced Motion, context invalidation and host unmount cleanup.
Real Left Dragged delivery, captured drags/releases crossing sidebar, Moved lost-release rollback, double-click and Enter/Space balanced reset.

Explicit consumer-owned single-writer local form fixture: atomic snapshot, immutable delivery revisions, interrupted reopen, controlled failure/retry and revision-specific acknowledgement; no network.
Existing Text/ScrollArea uses logical UTF-16 reading anchors across append and reflow; upward intent stops follow; existing Button explicitly returns to latest; manually reaching bottom never repins.
Existing Button/Checkbox inactive guards, Slider/Radio invalid layout cleanup, exclusive Switch pointer/Space activation, disabled semantic labels and navigation state/capture fixes.
Step rounding clamps to declared range; extreme finite ranges preserve finite normalized Slider geometry.
List/Tree/Table/Chart logical keyboard destinations are independent of ancestor pointer clipping; host reveals actual focused geometry and preserves generic header controls.
Screen-edge overlay placement, constrained Popover dismiss measurement and Banner wrapping follow actual available geometry without changing normal sizes.

Property and edge actions wrap through measured rows; Settings gaps, master-detail strides and Separator variants adapt to narrow/large text; document extents derive from real layout with fixed preview viewport.
Tabs/Menu/Dialog/Select comparisons use actual views; unsupported states/edge routes are not advertised; matrix presentation is static under a scoped renderer context and does not reset host clock.
Real Checkbox labels and mixed/checked combinations; real extended views including SegmentedControl; matrix captions and controls use matched text metrics, responsive widths and focus gutters.

Banner/Toast use narrow stacked actions and measured content; feedback Gallery uses document bounds with actual ancestor clipping and measured natural bottom; real scrolling and pointer dismiss tested.
CodeBlock and DiffView measure the same inner width used to render; Gallery code height uses matching insets; narrow large-type code is rendered to actual GPU output.

Full production layout frames are registered independently of pointer clipping; eligibility and mounted state control Tab participation. Shell, story and leaf scopes hand off bidirectionally. AppKit command-only Tab enters the same path, rapid repeated keys reveal from the last layout origin, and actual pointer focus synchronizes the logical owner. Dialog containment and nonmodal popup exit remain separate contracts.

Toolbar/NumberField/navigation/collection/feedback state and variant comparisons render real production views with isolated fixtures. Full Gallery GPU captures include every implemented advertised state/variant route at top/mid/bottom across four themes and two window/text-size combinations.
The production NumberField value is vertically and horizontally centered in its full slot, including compressed widths and 150 percent text. Actual CoreText glyph bounds and GPU output are checked.

TextArea uses measured remaining preview space and clipped rendering while keeping an offscreen logical frame. Selectable readonly text joins Tab. Sidebar focus reveal reserves the DS focus ring gutter; pointer focus in navigation search clears the old component focus without discarding input data.

requirements.observation: Warm neutral roles are brand-independent; verify sustained page appearance in four themes.
requirements.next_action: Review long text, normal/disabled text and neutral hierarchy on actual screens.

requirements.observation: 13 registered compiler-generated presets and explicit draft/confirm preview are wired.
requirements.next_action: Keep semantic role and 13-brand contrast guards; verify real overlays under every applied preset.

requirements.observation: Every implemented canonical page and advertised story is included in deterministic scene/action-geometry review at normal and narrow/150% text across four themes. Focused real GPU page frames supplement this; native sustained reading remains incomplete.
requirements.next_action: Review remaining native whole-page typography/spacing and physical display matrix; geometry checks alone do not assess readability.

requirements.observation: Four semantic roles exist; document-canvas intentionally maps surface-1 rather than attachment surface-0.
requirements.next_action: Document the role mapping difference and validate real canvas/region/panel/overlay hierarchy before changing approved background.

requirements.observation: Menu/Popover/Dialog consume JSON two-layer Gaussian elevation through shared production surface paint; panels remain flat and IC has explicit boundaries without shadow.
requirements.next_action: Review physical screen appearance and overlay edge placement; GPU raster checks cover 4 themes at 1x/2x.

requirements.observation: Independent 2pt + 2pt neutral focus ring preserves error/required boundaries; scoped focus gutter and true ancestor clips are implemented.
requirements.next_action: Finish page-by-page physical boundary/focus review without changing required-control contrast.

requirements.observation: Button sizes consume component aliases; shared Canvas/Panel/Floating/Dialog/Code surfaces use semantic roles. Row and Column remain separate tokens; no confirmed misuse found. Historical Showcase is calibration, not a duplicate live component.
requirements.next_action: Finish native semantic radius review; do not replace historical calibration fixtures or force Column onto unrelated surfaces.

requirements.observation: Concentric formula is corrected and tested; real nested component coverage remains incomplete.
requirements.next_action: Add real concentric fixtures where actually applicable; do not force the rule onto unrelated adjacent shapes.

requirements.observation: Focus paint space and document-space reveal are wired for existing workbench controls; GPU focus/shadow evidence covers 1x/2x; physical display review remains.
requirements.next_action: Audit remaining offscreen roving focus and fractional/physical display edges, without promoting untested experience.

requirements.observation: Explicit JSON production bindings: Button press60/hover200ms, Switch thumb120ms, Disclosure reveal300ms; legacy recipes preserved.
requirements.next_action: Review timing on real interactions before any shared visual tuning; no performance acceptance in this phase.

requirements.observation: Button/Switch/Disclosure production channels plus Menu/Dialog/Popover paint-only presence lifecycle and shared menu consumers are wired; remaining component state channels are not universally animated.
requirements.next_action: Review real intermediate frames and complete remaining per-component applicable state coverage.

requirements.observation: Split native drag/capture/reset chain and production control reversal/cancellation covered; append reading anchors preserve manual intent.
requirements.next_action: Retain full native assistive-input and real capture-loss review; do not infer all gestures accepted.

requirements.observation: Existing control and overlay presence paths consume renderer/system Reduced Motion; transitions finish without replay; menu scroll remains independently adapted.
requirements.next_action: Audit remaining applicable component motion channels and native system preference/VoiceOver paths.

requirements.observation: Pre-blur composition guard protects matching pointer submit; committed form draft persistence skips marked preedit.
requirements.next_action: Perform physical IME composition/commit/cancel and suggestion priority checks; model guards are not physical IME acceptance.

requirements.observation: Existing real form has explicit opt-in single-writer Rust atomic snapshot/outbox fixture; retry retains immutable revision and stale acknowledgement cannot erase newer edits.
requirements.next_action: Native process restart retained the fixture draft and acknowledged revision; continue physical IME and storage-boundary review without claiming real power-loss or real service acceptance.

requirements.observation: Text/ScrollArea adapter captures UTF-16 plus within-line anchor for append/reflow; upward user intent immediately leaves following mode.
requirements.next_action: Native check selection, append, resize and nested scrolling; arbitrary replacement/prepend is outside this append-only fixture.

requirements.observation: Actual existing Button action explicitly enables following; appends/timers and manual arrival at bottom cannot repin.
requirements.next_action: Native check click, keyboard and body focus transfer after latest action.

requirements.observation: Media viewer contract is specified-not-implemented.
requirements.next_action: Requires media capability outside current no-new-component phase; retain explicit missing status and required zoom/pan/resize tests.

requirements.observation: Split minima and keyboard restore after constrained resize are implemented; media pan remains missing.
requirements.next_action: Review existing keyboard/double-click two-pane recovery on physical input; media pan remains separately missing.

requirements.observation: Existing Split consumes native Dragged across sidebar, cancels lost release/invalid layout/focus loss, resets through double-click and Enter/Space. Media alternatives remain missing.
requirements.next_action: Complete native split reset/cancel checks and retain missing media scope separately.

requirements.observation: Production views own state, layout and interaction; complete logical layout frames now support ordinary offscreen Tab/reveal with shell and leaf scope handoff. Native samples verify pointer/input ownership, modal restore and text viewport fill. Per-control AX projection and comprehensive native acceptance remain missing.
requirements.next_action: Continue full per-component native keyboard/IME/assistive-technology acceptance; do not infer it from state matrices or sampled screenshots.

requirements.observation: Applicable production state and variant stories now cover remaining existing models with isolated fixtures. Every implemented advertised state/variant route is GPU captured at three actual scroll positions across four themes and two window/text-size combinations. Native samples are recorded separately; the AX bridge remains missing.
requirements.next_action: Continue comprehensive native interaction, physical IME and AX bridge/VoiceOver acceptance. Revisit new or changed component contracts without treating passive models as interactive states.

requirements.observation: Five actual patterns and Settings remain interactive; measured action rows, form error/disabled/reset, master-detail row stride and explicit durable/retry fixture are exercised. Native complete combinations are not universally accepted.
requirements.next_action: Complete representative native narrow/large-type combinations; keep deterministic local async/durable fixture boundary explicit.

next_implementation_order: native component/page interaction and visual review against per-component records
extend applicable state comparisons where currently absent using real views
native per-control macOS accessibility bridge and physical IME/VoiceOver acceptance
media capability after explicit no-new-component scope changes

cross_component_gaps.observation: The platform installs one TekesView implementing NSTextInputClient but no per-control NSAccessibility role/name/value/children/focus projection is present. System accessibility preferences are separate from exposing control semantics.
cross_component_gaps.next_action: Implement consumer/control semantics to macOS AX tree, then run native VoiceOver checks; do not present keyboard or IME support as AX acceptance.

cross_component_gaps.description: Current layout registers complete logical frames independently of visible pointer hits. Tab and Shift+Tab reveal ordinary offscreen actions, use one roving stop per group, and hand off between shell and real previews. Native narrow-window samples verify forward/backward Settings input/action traversal, popup exit and Motion reveal; complete all-page native acceptance remains unverified.
